$metadata.description: Lean starter schema for SEC Filing.

title: SEC Filing Starter Schema
description: Lean starter schema for SEC Filing. Expand field detail and runtime presentation only after the first extraction pass.

source_document.description: Source context for the filing detail page or downloaded artifact.

file_name.description: Name of the acquired source file exactly as stored in the documents directory.

source_url.description: Original acquisition URL for the filing detail page or downloaded artifact. Null if unavailable.

filings.description: Structured summary of a filing represented by the acquired document. Create one row per filing described by the source page.

company_name.description: Company or registrant name exactly as shown on the filing detail page.

cik.description: Central Index Key if present on the page. Null if unavailable.

filing_type.description: SEC filing form type exactly as written, such as 10-Q, 10-K, or 8-K.

filing_title.description: Human-readable filing title or page headline. Null if the page only provides the form type.

filing_date.description: Filing date in YYYY-MM-DD when available. Preserve the source text only if a precise ISO date cannot be determined.

period_end.description: Reporting period end date or quarter end when present. Null if unavailable.

accession_number.description: SEC accession number if present. Null if unavailable on the source page.

sec_archive_url.description: Direct SEC archive URL or filing resource URL referenced by the source page. Null if unavailable.

source_detail_url.description: URL of the acquired filing detail page used as the extraction source. Null if unavailable.

summary.description: Short narrative summary of the filing detail page or filing purpose. Null if unavailable.
